scope: User requested pickup, introduction, and return for three products. Clear visible release is the operational completion criterion; portrait-only models are assessed only for speech.

criteria.observable: 目标罐离开桌面进入手中，总数仍为三罐。
同一罐持续在手中，身份、颜色与形状保持稳定；口型随同一配音运动。
商品回到桌面，手与商品出现可见间隔后商品保持稳定；仅接触静帧不能确定是否仍用力握持。
连续帧与播放中没有明显人物、脸部或姿态切换；闭嘴单帧不直接等于音画延迟。

packaging_note: Input LTX video already contains incorrect printed lettering. Preserve versus improve lettering are distinct from inventing additional cans or changing target SKU colors.
